entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at workbench height, 100mm look, very shallow depth of field, the flask in crisp focus.
entries.subject: Two hands in stained leather gloves, cropped at the wrists, hold up a round glass flask of glowing emerald elixir above a cluttered alchemist's workbench; the liquid swirls into a bright spiral and a bubble of liquid light floats up out of the neck. Beside it stand a rack of stoppered vials in every colour, a brass alembic dripping glowing drops, coiled copper tubing and a mortar of crushed leaves, with curls of coloured steam. Behind, a blurred stone workshop with shelves of jars and warm lantern light.
entries.accent: bubbling emerald-green elixir with warm amber glass reflections

entries.camera: Low-angle shot from ground level beside the barrel, wide lens, the cannon foreshortened and towering against the sky.
entries.subject: A compact eldritch cannon of brass and dark iron on a tripod on a castle rampart at dusk, firing: a roaring ball of arcane fire with a white-hot core leaves the glowing muzzle, ringed by floating concentric hoops of light and a shockwave that bends the smoke. The recoil kicks sparks and loose stones off the parapet. Far away on a ridge an empty ruined watchtower is about to be hit. Only a gloved hand on the firing lever is visible, cropped at the wrist.
entries.accent: blazing vermilion fire and white-hot sparks against a smoky dusk-rose sky

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder medium-wide shot, 35mm, the smith's dark shoulder blurred in the foreground, the construct in sharp focus beyond.
entries.subject: A leather-aproned smith seen only from behind, a dark shoulder and the back of a head, blurred in the foreground. Beyond, in sharp focus, stands a steel defender: a stocky construct of riveted steel plates on four sturdy legs, with a blank helmet-like head and a glowing amber core in its chest, planting a heavy shield into the floor as a volley of arcane bolts bursts against it in showers of sparks. Behind them, a forge workshop with an anvil, hanging tools and orange coals.
entries.accent: warm brass-gold forge light on cool steel grey

entries.camera: Symmetrical front-on medium shot at chest height, 50mm, frozen mid-motion, the armour dead centre in the frame.
entries.subject: A suit of arcane plate armour assembles itself around an unseen wearer in the middle of a dim workshop: gauntlets, greaves, pauldrons and a smooth blank-faced helm with a single dark visor slit lock into place from every direction, frozen mid-motion, the seams between the plates glowing. One fist is a heavy thunder gauntlet wrapped in a tight crackling ring of energy. Loose rivets, sparks and small gears hang in the air around it.
entries.accent: electric ice-blue light in the seams of dark gunmetal steel

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, wide lens, the darkest part of the table at the bottom of the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a round dark-wood table covered by a huge old map drawn in decorative linework with no lettering. Miniature mountains, forests and rivers rise from the paper in glowing relief, and a thread of golden light winds across them toward a small glowing doorway of folded paper. Two hands, cropped at the wrists, hold a brass divider and a compass with a blank face. Loose folded map pages drift in a slow ring around the table, their edges glowing.
entries.accent: warm parchment gold with deep sea-teal

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) low shot from the foot of the slab, wide lens, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: In a storm-struck tower laboratory, a patchwork construct creature sits up on a stone slab, clearly artificial: assembled from mismatched dark leather, canvas, brass plates and wooden joints held together with thick stitching, with a blank mask-like head and a single pale glowing eye. A lightning bolt jumps from a copper conductor coil overhead into its chest, throwing violet arcs along the stitched seams. Cables, glass jars and a bubbling flask crowd the shelves behind.
entries.accent: electric violet lightning against bone-white light and bruise-purple shadow
